steps.name: last seen
steps.detail: {"outcome": "found_and_followed", "summary": "The coordinator confirmed P1: short dark hair, black leather jacket, grey top, dark trousers. P1 was first seen about 4 m east of takeoff. The drone followed P1 for 90 s and put 49 position pins on the map. Last position: about 2.3 m west and 2.6 m south of takeoff, nearly stationary (0.05 m/s), facing west-north-west (289\u00b0). The lock was weak: it held only 47% of the time and lost the person 7 times. A second person, P2, with a similar dark jacket (match 0.73, not reviewed) was about 10 m west, so pins may have jumped between the two. The ground team should check the face on arrival. No phone GPS was available to check the pins against."}
